description: This file contains implementation code for an ADC (Analog-to-Digital Converter) driver in an AUTOSAR-based embedded system. It includes function definitions for validating ADC states and configurations, managing group status, enabling/disabling notifications, and error checking routines.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType ValidateInit(Adc_StateType adcState,Adc_APIServiceIDType api)
methods.description: Validates whether ADC is initialized before performing operations.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType ValidateGroup(const Adc_ConfigType * ConfigPtr,Adc_GroupType group,Adc_APIServiceIDType api)
methods.description: Validates whether the given ADC group is within range and the config pointer is valid.

methods.name: Adc_StatusType Adc_InternalGetGroupStatus(Adc_StateType adcState,const Adc_ConfigType * ConfigPtr,Adc_GroupType group)
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of an ADC group, performing validation if enabled.

methods.name: void Adc_EnableInternalGroupNotification(Adc_StateType adcState,const Adc_ConfigType * ConfigPtr,Adc_GroupType group)
methods.description: Enables notification callback for a specific ADC group.

methods.name: void Adc_InternalDisableGroupNotification(Adc_StateType adcState,const Adc_ConfigType * ConfigPtr,Adc_GroupType group)
methods.description: Disables notification callback for a specific ADC group.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType Adc_CheckReadGroup(Adc_StateType adcState,const Adc_ConfigType * ConfigPtr,Adc_GroupType group)
methods.description: Checks if the ADC group is ready for a read operation.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType Adc_CheckStartGroupConversion(Adc_StateType adcState,const Adc_ConfigType * ConfigPtr,Adc_GroupType group)
methods.description: Checks whether starting a group conversion is valid, including buffer and trigger source validation.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType Adc_CheckStopGroupConversion(Adc_StateType adcState,const Adc_ConfigType * ConfigPtr,Adc_GroupType group)
methods.description: Validates if stopping a conversion for a group is permissible based on current status.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType Adc_CheckInit(Adc_StateType adcState,const Adc_ConfigType * ConfigPtr)
methods.description: Validates if ADC is uninitialized before initializing.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType Adc_CheckDeInit(Adc_StateType adcState,const Adc_ConfigType * ConfigPtr)
methods.description: Checks if ADC can be de-initialized, ensuring all groups are idle or completed.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType Adc_CheckSetupResultBuffer(Adc_StateType adcState,const Adc_ConfigType * ConfigPtr,Adc_GroupType group)
methods.description: Validates configuration for setting up the result buffer for a group.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType Adc_CheckGetStreamLastPointer(Adc_StateType adcState,const Adc_ConfigType * ConfigPtr,Adc_GroupType group)
methods.description: Checks if getting the last stream pointer is valid based on current ADC state and status.
